title: Shogi: Japanese chess with piece drops and promotion
description: 9x9 grid, 2 players, 20 pieces each. Unique mechanics: captured pieces go to opponent's hand and can be dropped back onto the board (piece recycling). Promotion zone (last 3 ranks). Multiple piece types with directional movement (gold, silver, knight, lance, rook, bishop, king, pawn). Promotion changes movement patterns. Drop restrictions: no two pawns in same column, no pawn drop checkmate, no drops on last rank for pieces that can't move. Already have shogi pieces in registry (registry/pieces/).
